lessons.title: The Legacy — Joy as a Lifelong Act

body.text: Goals: Teach why Maze matters beyond charts. Maze didn’t chase trends. Didn’t chase radio. Didn’t chase drama. They chased VIBE, COMMUNITY, LOVE, TOGETHERNESS. Teach your son: Sometimes the biggest impact ain’t fame — it’s the feeling you leave behind in people’s lives. Maze = generational memory.

finalProject.prompt: Explain how Frankie Beverly & Maze shaped Black cultural tradition through live instrumentation, community-centered themes, and timeless grooves. Compare ONE early track (‘Joy & Pain’ or ‘Before I Let Go’) with ONE mid-career track (‘Golden Time of Day’ or ‘We Are One’). Identify TWO modern artists or bands who reflect the Maze influence in warmth, groove, or community impact.
